title: Add retention dry-run report
summary: Add a backend-owned retention dry-run report for logs, JSONL/state files, scratch/temp orphans, failure reports, and cache artifacts without deleting or moving files.
reason: The autonomy hardening plan needs cleanup visibility before any retention mutation can be considered. The first slice must prove cleanup candidates are allowlisted, source roots are excluded, and parked pending-publish files are not removal candidates.
behavior_before: The Local API did not expose a focused retention dry-run payload for autonomy cleanup budgets, so operators could not audit accumulated runtime artifacts through a machine-readable maintenance command.
behavior_after: The Local API exposes a read-only retention dry-run command that reports eligible runtime artifacts and guardrail exclusions while leaving sources, pending publish files, and all filesystem state untouched.
manual_validation: Normalized packet type from unsupported safety to supported feature for change-control schema validation
pytest tests/python/desktop/test_maintenance_retention_dry_run.py -q - initially failed before implementation (missing facade method and 404 route)
refresh_summaries targeted retention dry-run files - passed (2 written, 13 unchanged)
rollback_plan: Remove the retention dry-run implementation, route contract updates, tests, generated summaries, and this change packet.
notes: Dry-run only. This change must not delete, move, or rewrite source media, scratch files, parked pending-publish payloads, manifests, or state files.
